overall: Atlanta topped out at 80.6°F around 3 PM and has held flat at that level through 5 PM before cooling into the evening. As of 21:49 ET the temperature has dropped to 73.4°F and is cooling at -1.8°F/hr, confirming the daily peak is well behind us. The day ran noticeably cooler than model guidance suggested, likely due to cloud cover, timing of mixing, or a boundary that limited afternoon heating.
forecast_obs_notes: All three models (ECMWF 82.6°F, HRRR 82.5°F, NBM 82.3°F) were tightly clustered and in strong agreement, yet collectively overshot the observed high by roughly 1.7–2.0°F. The odd ensemble's modal tier of 81–82°F at 28% confidence was the closest to reality, while the even ensemble's 84–85°F tier at only 18% probability was well off the mark.
max_temp_prediction: The daily high is effectively locked in at 80.6°F. With current temperature at 73.4°F, a cooling rate of -1.8°F/hr, and the clock past 9:45 PM ET, there is no plausible pathway to exceed the existing running max tonight. Confidence is extremely high — this is an observational certainty rather than a forecast at this point.
